jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Counts

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"}

-- go.mod --

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestCounts_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"alice":3,"bob":7}`)
	var c Counts
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if c["alice"] != 3 || c["bob"] != 7 {
		t.Errorf("got %#v, want {alice:3, bob:7}", c)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(c)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	// jsonv2 sorts map keys.
	if string(out) != `{"alice":3,"bob":7}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, `{"alice":3,"bob":7}`)
	}
}
